correctness.rationale: Finite Boolean saturation iff all r distinct coatom columns occur; this holds in both directions, including r=1 and m=0. Disjoint column events give inclusion–exclusion and factorial moments. Since t≤1/r, the critical-window log-error m t² vanishes without restrictions on varying p; Poisson moments establish the limit, while union and variance bounds cover both sides. Small-instance brute-force enumeration independently reproduced exact counts.
